object.name: session_manager
object.description: Privileged interface for registering owned sessions. Only accessible to root clients.

c2s.name: create_session

description.summary: start registering a new session, returning an owning session object

c2s.description: The leader PID and optional fields may be staged before commit finalizes the configuration and creates the session.

object.name: session_management_session

description.summary: owning handle for a session created via create_session

object.description: The leader PID and optional fields may be sent while the session is staged. Setting remote_host marks the session as remote. Once the session has been committed, modifying staged fields or committing it again is a protocol error. Destroying this object tears down the session and its resources.

c2s.name: vt
c2s.description: Optional. Must be sent while staged. Defaults to 0 (not bound to a VT).

c2s.name: remote_host

description.summary: stage the remote host and mark the session as remote

c2s.description: Optional. Must be sent while staged.

c2s.name: class
c2s.description: Optional. Must be sent while staged. Defaults to user.

c2s.name: env
c2s.description: Optional. Must be sent while staged. May be sent multiple times.

s2c.name: env
s2c.description: Sent once after session_id, while the session is still staged, including when the array is empty. Each entry is KEY=VALUE; split at the first equals sign because values may contain equals signs. This completes the initial environment snapshot but does not indicate that session resources exist.

s2c.name: done

description.summary: commit succeeded and session setup is complete

s2c.description: The leader has been placed in its session cgroup. The client may now release the leader to execute the session command.

c2s.name: commit

description.summary: commit staged fields and create the session

c2s.description: Finalizes the staged configuration and creates the session, replying with done on success or error on failure. Both leader and delegate_cgroup are optional. If neither is set, the PID from the client's peer credentials (ucreds) is used as the session leader. Sending both is a protocol error. Commit consumes the staged session even on failure; retrying requires a new session object. No fields may be changed after commit, and committing an already-created session is a protocol error.

c2s.name: leader
c2s.description: Optional. Must be sent while staged. Supplies the process ID of the leader to place in the session cgroup when committed. Sending both leader and delegate_cgroup for the same session, in either order, is a protocol error.

arg.name: leader_pid
arg.summary: process ID of the session leader

value.name: user
value.summary: interactive login session owned by a user

value.name: greeter
value.summary: login prompt or display manager session

value.name: lock_screen
value.summary: screen locker session associated with an existing login

value.name: background
value.summary: non-interactive user session without an attached seat or VT

value.name: background_light
value.summary: lightweight background session excluded from idle shutdown accounting

value.name: manager_early
value.summary: early per-user service manager session created before a regular login
